stricter_readings: LOO minimum None (one run or an undefined LOO ratio) does not clear any bar (family S, P1(i)).
Matched-FDP ratio not evaluable also when fdp_reached is not True on both sides or the CI is not finite (A5.5.4 names only >5% NaN draws).
v2_sep void: union of a3_secondary.void_flags and a recomputation from the per-arm verdicts.

Family S S1 with no 'supported' own-q comparator: S1's own-q part is not met, so S1 is not rejected and the sequence stops (A3.3.5 gives the 'not tested' rule for S5 only; A5.9.2's 'rests on (i)' is written for P1 only).

A6 FAILED keeps the FAILED state even if its gate output cannot be verified (it can only void); this departs from A6.2's literal 'unverifiable -> stopped' and needs PI confirmation as a deviation. PASS needs a verifiable gate output and a step-5 commit that is an ancestor of the look base commit, else 'stopped: node time limit'.
A6 PASS also needs its step-5 commit dated no later than the A6 clock's step-5 deadline (config a6.pass_deadline, 17:55 CET 2026-10-28; A6.8.2/D31.3), else 'stopped: node time limit'.

A6 is v1-only (D32): v2_sep wording (L-Q, L-R, title) is always the no-A6 wording; its C9 clause says so; the A5.7.2 'v2_sep FAILED a completed null-spectrum test' trigger has no input and cannot fire (stated in claims.md).
In the A6 PASS state the designation is not changed by this script (A5.10.6 is a separate act); the L-D label is printed unchanged with that note.

Arm M (T5) verdicts enter L-E for v1/v2_sep lists at peptidoform and sequence; 'not applicable to this unit' at protein level.  Arm M has no paired control, so '(consistent with control)' is never attached to it.
Sealed run counts (6 T1, 2 T5) and 15 arm-M replicates are part of the completeness rule; sealed inputs require the ledger manifest hashes (run() refuses without them).
Claim-level arm-C void also when the arm-C LB lower CI is missing or not finite.
Headline comparator: the lowest FINITE P1(i) point ratio; a None ratio (0 comparator IDs) never headlines; ties by comparator name; with no finite ratio the first A1 comparator by name is named.
A5.9.3 PASS wording: the '(…)' of L-S's pass clause is filled with '(A1, 2026-10-27: tail-G2, G1, G3)', the gates named in A5.4.

Own-q ratios carry no n_boot_nan: evaluate.py floors the comparator denominator at 1e-9, so an own-q bootstrap draw cannot be NaN; A5.5.4's 'every bootstrap's n_boot_nan' is read as every matched-FDP bootstrap.
A void (scorer-level or claim-level) is reported as 'VOID', never as 'not met'/'not rejected'; voided numbers are printed in full under captions titled 'VOID under §6.0d A5.7 (reason)'.
